message:
Add initial code for generating Apple profiles

This code adds new http handlers that will generate iOS and macOS
configuration profiles allowing us to override the Control server of the
official Tailscale.app.

Currently, macOS is working, as I have not found the correct "key" to
inject for iOS.

This means that a profile will allow users to no longer log in via the
command line, but they can use the app.

body:
Hmm yes, I am currently split between if I am just hitting the wrong key with my testing, having the same with the PayloadType, iOS instead of macOS seems like it would make sense which makes me think you are on to something.

If you are right that it's an iOS restriction, that would be a bummer.

Atm I am thinking: not ready to give up yet, and at least the macOS setup got neater.

I'm gonna continue to hunt among possible keys, but I guess I should do a better dive into mdm vs non mdm.


I guess one thing that makes me think I just got the wrong key is that while on macOS it shows the change in the profile, iOS shows "unknown payload".

Please keep me updated with your findings.

After you pointed out that this kind of change would require a mdm setup, I was thinking you might be on to something. 

It sounds like something (almost sensible) would do to prevent user from ending up being tricked to override "safe" app settings...

You mentioned you used Jamf, is there a "home setup" one can use to test? Or is it because you have an enterprise setup?

Yep I saw, it looks like it still [requires an Apple Enterprise Dev cert ($299/year)](https://github.com/micromdm/micromdm/blob/master/docs/user-guide/introduction.md#apple-requirements).

I'll have a play around to see if there is a local setup or something
so is there a write up which better explains how to accomplish this on OS X ?

> Btw, on macOS you could achieve the same result without mobileconfig whatsoever:
> `defaults write io.tailscale.ipn.macos ControlURL http://...`

Yep I noticed this as well, in terms of the feature of this PR, the macOS was a "bi-product" of trying to figure out how to fix the iOS part.

My current plan is to leave the profile for macOS but improve it with a "proper how-to" and also have the defaults alternative in the documentation (as in the /apple endpoint).

> so is there a write up which better explains how to accomplish this on OS X ?
Yep, as mentioned above, I just have not had any time to work on it lately


I have some vague ideas on what to try for iOS, but if I cant figure it out the next time I sit down, I might split this PR into a "macOS first" one and then leave the iOS as draft until I figure it out.

> > Yep, as mentioned above, I just have not had any time to work on it lately

how about a quick and dirty i have an immediate need to add a MAC OS X client to my headscale network, they have no linux :(

> > > Yep, as mentioned above, I just have not had any time to work on it lately
> 
> how about a quick and dirty i have an immediate need to add a MAC OS X client to my headscale network, they have no linux :(

You can do what @jilyaluk suggest with defaults. 

But please keep support requests off the pull requests discussion, it makes it hard for us to filter out relevant comments on how to solve this feature.
